results.original_name: El diario secreto de una profesional
results.overview: The adventures and misfortunes of Javiera, a young psychology student who works part-time in an insurence company at day...and as a high-class escort at night, she takes the name of Angela in an effort to keep her two lives separated.
results.name: El diario secreto de una profesional

results.overview: Chilean children's television show centered on a professor named "Professor Rossa", who taught about national animals and nature.
results.name: El mundo del Profesor Rossa

results.overview: Jay Sherman is a TV movie critic who is forced to review the most pathetic films which he always rates as "It stinks." In addition to the film parodies, the show also deals with his personal life: working for a tyrannical media mogul boss, his lovelife and his family.
results.name: The Critic

results.overview: A provocative legal drama focused on young associates at a bare-bones Boston firm and their scrappy boss, Bobby Donnell. The show's forte is its storylines about “people who walk a moral tightrope.”
results.name: The Practice

results.overview: Eddy, a math genius and small-time crook, avoids jail-time by going undercover as a teacher. His mission: to identify the kid of a major criminal.
results.name: Flunked

results.overview: Iris, The Happy Professor or was a Canadian-produced television puppet show that ran from 1992 to 1994, revolving around Professor Iris, a purple ibis who taught his class, which included his three students; Piano, Skeleton, and Plant. The Professor would teach a variety of subjects to his students and would always wear bowties based on whatever the lesson was, not unlike Ms. Frizzle and her dresses from The Magic School Bus. Also featured on the show was Ms. Principal, the school's headmistress who would often come in, complaining about the noises.
results.name: Iris, The Happy Professor

results.overview: A high school teacher in Austin tries to balance the competing demands of the students and their parents in a world where the rules seem to change every day.
results.name: English Teacher

results.overview: Women's Murder Club was an American police procedural and legal drama. Longtime friends involved in homicide investigations gather to work off the clock to solve cases. District Attorney Jill has issues with her past, medical examiner Claire is dealing with a husband newly in a wheelchair, and tough Detective Lindsay suddenly finds herself working under her ex-husband. Despite personal issues, they allow young reporter Cindy to join their "club."
results.name: Women's Murder Club

results.original_name: タツキ先生は甘すぎる！
results.overview: At an unconventional school for kids who avoid traditional classrooms, Tatsuki's carefree approach baffles strict Shizuku as they learn to reach students.
results.name: Tatsuki: Too Kind for School

results.overview: Professor Poopsnagle, the holder of an important scientific mystery, was kidnapped and his mysterious disappearance undermines the world of science. His young grandson, who helps him in research, provides assistance to professor Garcia, a longtime colleague and friend of the scientist. Helped by a group of children spending their holidays in a secret camp in the valley, Professor Garcia and the young boy build a flying bus. They set off in pursuit of the kidnappers and an attempt, at the same time to complete Poopsnagle's unfinished work.
results.name: Professor Poopsnagle's Steam Zeppelin

results.original_name: Il camorrista - Una serie di Giuseppe Tornatore
results.name: Il camorrista - Una serie di Giuseppe Tornatore

results.overview: A former policeman is tortured and murdered and his friend and former colleague investigates the case.
results.name: The Return of the Dancing Master

results.overview: Jesus of Nazareth, the founding figure of Christianity, is also an exceptional character in the Koran. Why? In what way? A deep investigation around the world exploring the rise of Islam during the time of prophet Muhammad.
results.name: Jesus and Islam

results.original_name: Professeur Raoult vs le gang des Cerises
results.overview: When Professor Didier Raoult promotes a "miracle cure" for COVID-19, six ordinary citizens go after the truth -- including his own daughter.
results.name: The Pandemic Prophet

results.overview: In this true-crime documentary, a cult expert and filmmaker infiltrate a polygamist sect to expose a self-proclaimed prophet and bring him to justice.
results.name: Trust Me: The False Prophet

results.overview: Professor Brian Cox asks the biggest questions we can ask. Are we alone? Why are we here? What is our future? Join him in a stunning celebration of human life as he explores our origins, our place and our destiny in the universe.
results.name: Human Universe

results.overview: Featuring interviews with his followers, critics and Raël himself, this docuseries traces how a UFO-inspired religion spiraled into a controversial cult.
results.name: Raël: The Alien Prophet
